scripts.dev:free: concurrently "npm run voice:start" "VOICE_PROVIDER=free npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.voice:setup: cd voice-server && ${PYTHON:-python3.11} -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
